missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ветер' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'дует'. 'Сильный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'сегодня' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. As an inanimate masculine noun, 'ветер' is identical in the accusative, here the object of 'чувствую'. 'Холодный' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. After 'нет', the noun becomes genitive 'ветра', with the fleeting 'е' dropping out of the stem. 'Совсем' emphasises the calm.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К ветру' uses the dative after 'к', with the fleeting vowel dropped. The tree leans towards the wind.
Strategic focus: Locative prepositional. 'На ветру' uses the special locative ending '-у' after 'на' to mark the conditions. A fixed phrase for being out in the wind.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о ветре и дожде.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О ветре' uses the ordinary prepositional after 'о' to mark the topic, keeping the fleeting vowel. It pairs naturally with 'дожде'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Ветром' is the instrumental form after 'с', here the fleeting vowel drops. The ship sails along with the wind.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'из-за'. 'Ветра' is genitive following 'из-за', giving the cause. The wind is the reason the tree fell.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Ветры' is the nominative plural subject of 'дуют'. 'Холодные' agrees in the plural, and 'зимой' is an instrumental adverb of time.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Ветрами' is the instrumental plural after 'с', expressing what the boat struggles against. A vivid model for the instrumental plural.
